description: The bar chart illustrates Shapley values by relative position to a probed target word, with values averaged over 247 tasks. The horizontal axis displays the categorical relative positions, ordered sequentially from left to right: L4+, L3, L2, L1, T, R1, R2, R3, and R4+. The vertical axis is a linear value axis labeled "Shapley value," ranging from 0 to 80 with numeric tick marks at regular intervals of 20. The chart features grouped vertical bars, where each position category contains up to three adjacent bars representing different models, as defined by a legend in the upper right: mBERT (light blue), XLM-R (dark blue), and chLSTM (light green). The tallest bars are located at the central position T, where mBERT is approximately 59, XLM-R is approximately 55, and chLSTM reaches the maximum approximate value of 78. The shortest bars are found at positions L3 and R3, where values for all three models are near zero, with the chLSTM bars being nearly imperceptible. The categories are sorted logically by their relative spatial position rather than by numerical value, and no specific bars are visually emphasized with outlines or shading beyond their standard legend colors.
